pages.text: Two circuits, each a capacitor and a coil, each ringing at its own frequency. Tune the primary to the secondary and energy sloshes across - and appears at a voltage higher by $(thing)√(C₁/C₂)$(): kilovolts in, megavolts out.

The secondary of the $(item)Tesla Coil$() rings at 159 kHz. Set the primary capacitance and where its spiral is tapped (inductance grows as the turns squared) so it rings there too; a few per cent off and most of the energy stays in the primary. In air an arc reaches about a metre for every 700 kV.

Its arcs fix the air's nitrogen into nitrates - the Birkeland-Eyde process that made the first fertilisers: water becomes bone meal. Arcs over 2.5 m fuse sand into glass, as lightning makes fulgurites: Fused Silica, without the Sun.
Stand well clear. A running coil strikes anyone within six blocks of it.
